purpose: Read and update scoped vault notes without crossing allowed folders.

trigger: Find the architecture decision in my Obsidian vault
Update the agent notes in the approved project folder
Create a note documenting today's verified work
do_not_trigger: Edit files outside the Obsidian vault

preflight: Resolve the exact owner-authorized vault root and write allowlist.
Use scoped MCP or filesystem adapter that validates realpath and symlink boundaries.
Read exact existing file version before proposing an edit.
workflow: Read and search only permitted vault paths.
For writes, preserve frontmatter, links and surrounding sections.
Apply a compare-and-swap style file revision check.
Read back file hash and record the updated path and revision.

evidence.how_to_verify: Resolve vault-relative path and permitted root without traversal.
Read back edited note content hash after a scoped write.

failure_modes: If MCP is disconnected, mark synchronization pending and do not claim an edit.
If the note changed concurrently, stop instead of overwriting another agent.
